description: Production-locale keys that need a linguistic approval record before a production release. Generated from the PENDING LINGUISTIC REVIEW markers: the 33 AS-1 keys per Swiss locale, the Swiss Phase 2 P0 drafts and corrections, and the Swiss Phase 3 P1 drafts and corrections (de_CH 530, fr_CH 508, it_CH 432). A key stays here after its marker is removed: only a valid record in records/ approves it.
